metadata.department: Agricultural  Economics, Extension and Rural Development

module_catalog.name: Leadership and group dynamics 712
module_catalog.content: Nature, philosophy and objectives of Extension.  The group as channel and instrument in extension; definitions and characteristics of groups; group formation; theories regarding the functioning of groups; group norms; group goals;  small group techniques;  rural groups and their engagement;  definitions and theories of leadership;  behaviour and attitude in group work;  the extensionist as professional leader;  group analysis in group context and process;  training of leaders.  Conflict resolution, mediation and negotiation.  Ethics in extension and agricultural development.  Management in extension;  Strategic planning;  functions of management.
module_catalog.contact_time: 1 four-hour lecture in 5 block week sessions
